description: LEFT=SDR h264 trimmed to source_frame=124 (no intro). RIGHT=HDR VP9 from source_frame=0 (has 124 frames of intro content before the aligned region). At both sides raw=0, LEFT shows source[124] and RIGHT shows source[0] — misaligned. To align, RIGHT must advance by 124 frames (~2069 ms at 59.94 fps) so both show source[124]. Target effective_time_shift ≈ +2069 ms.

check_points.rationale: First aligned frame: left raw=0 (left frame 0) matches right raw=2069000us (right frame 124).
Mid-content: aligned frame sits in each side's history/prefetch area when the other is at the press point.
Further into content: tests that alignment holds past the first GOP boundary in both encodings.
